items.a: An app for amateur tennis players who play singles matches. Record your scores, have your opponent confirm them, and follow your level and rankings.

Once your opponent confirms the score, the match can count towards your level. Recording an unconfirmed score is not enough. Matches do not all carry the same weight: repeated matches against the same opponent can have less effect.

items.q: Do I have a different level in each ranking?
items.a: No. You have one level. Club, province, autonomous community and Spain rankings are different views of that same level. You keep your level when you change clubs.
Your level still needs more information to settle. It takes at least five rated matches, but may take more. In the meantime, you appear in every ranking with a Provisional label.

items.q: Can I play someone from another club?
items.a: Yes. You can record a singles match against another player in the app, even if their home club is different from yours.
